    p = lambda v, d=(0, 0): (int(v[0]), int(v[1])) if isinstance(v, (list, tuple)) and len(v) >= 2 else d
    s = lambda x: 1 if x > 0 else (-1 if x < 0 else 0)
    md = lambda a, b: abs(a[0] - b[0]) + abs(a[1] - b[1])

    w = int(g("grid_width", 0) or 0)
    h = int(g("grid_height", 0) or 0)
    me = p(g("self_position", (0, 0)))
    op = p(g("opponent_position", (0, 0)))
    res = [p(x, None) for x in (g("resources", []) or [])]
    obs = set(p(x, None) for x in (g("obstacles", []) or []))
    obs.discard(None)

    moves = [[0, 0], [1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]]

    def ok(a):
        x, y = a
        return 0 <= x < w and 0 <= y < h and (x, y) not in obs

    best = None
    bd = 10**9
    for r in res:
        d = md(me, r)
        if d < bd:
            bd = d
            best = r

    if md(me, op) <= 2:
        cand += [[s(me[0] - op[0]), s(me[1] - op[1])], [s(me[0] - op[0]), 0], [0, s(me[1] - op[1])]]

    cand += [[0, 0], [1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]]

            best_score = sc
